content: Two patterns for gating accuracy harness in Rust CI: (1) Cargo feature gate: add bench-accuracy feature to Cargo.toml; annotate harness test file with #[cfg(feature = "bench-accuracy")]; CI runs cargo test --features bench-accuracy only in scheduled/manual jobs. (2) Env-var runtime skip: test checks std::env::var("ANOFOX_DATASET_DIR").ok() and calls return early or uses the path; standard CI just doesn't set the var so tests are silently skipped (use ignore attribute pattern). Pattern (2) is simpler — no extra Cargo feature needed, no compile overhead. Pattern (1) is cleaner for compile-time exclusion. Combining both is common: feature gate for compile-time exclusion from default builds, env var for dataset path.
